name: Mineko
source:
Mineko is a friendly but shy and a somewhat clumsy young woman. She tends to see the best in everyone she meets. Mineko worked at the Beach Bounce Resort as a Greeter.

In Beauty Bounce, Mineko is said to have left the Beach Bounce to finish university.
